data.standardized_narrative: For 2019, Syndicate 1969 experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of $9.07 million, representing 1.60% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was primarily driven by deterioration on Non-Marine Liability reserves, specifically due to adverse loss experience in the US Open market sub-class from individual large losses, as well as an increase in claims frequency and higher insured claims. Conversely, estimates for 2018 catastrophe events remained stable, indicating no further deterioration from those events.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure of $9.070m is stated within the context of "net calendar year claims incurred", but is presented in the "6. Technical provisions" note, which typically refers to gross figures. It is assumed to be gross for this extraction. The gross claims development triangle on page 27 does not show year-on-year movements for prior underwriting years, making it unsuitable for calculating prior year development.
